You will lead change initiatives from solution design through implementation and UAT while strengthening governance, reporting, risk management, and operational capability to deliver sustainable business outcomes and continuous improvement.

**About The Role**

**The Role: Lead Quality Engineer**
**The Team**
Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements.
  
  
Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions.
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability.
  
  
**The Impact**
As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality.
  
  
This role requires strong technical expertise, a solid understanding of financial risk platforms, and the ability to lead quality initiatives across agile delivery teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously improve the quality strategy across the full software development lifecycle, embedding effective quality gates from requirements and design through release and production support.
* Shift quality engineering from defect detection to defect prevention by identifying risks, control gaps, and testability concerns early in the delivery process.
* Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable automated test frameworks covering UI, API, data, integration, regression, and other relevant testing areas.
* Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test suites based on software requirements, technical specifications, business workflows, and real-world customer usage.
* Drive risk-based testing for financial risk platforms, prioritising coverage for regulatory workflows, calculation accuracy, data integrity, security controls, system integration, and customer-critical journeys.
* Design and implement test automation using Java, Python, Selenium, Cucumber, Carina, and other appropriate technologies and frameworks.
* Establish and monitor quality engineering standards and metrics, including automation coverage, defect leakage, release readiness, test reliability, environment stability, and production incident feedback.
* Champion continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines by integrating reliable and efficient automated validation into build, deployment, and release processes.
* Improve release confidence and operational resilience by validating deployment readiness, rollback capability, observability, environment consistency, and applicable non-functional requirements.
* Lead quality governance for agile teams, ensuring that acceptance criteria, test evidence, sign-offs, and release risks are clearly documented, auditable, and decision-ready.
* Manage and support QA and UAT environments, build deployments, test data, test execution, release planning, and testing sign-off activities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support to resolve quality issues and strengthen end-to-end software reliability.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand business impact and translate workflow complexity and customer needs into effective test coverage.
* Use AI and modern engineering practices to improve QA productivity through intelligent test generation, defect analysis, regression optimisation, log analysis, and test data creation.
* Mentor QA engineers and influence developers to build quality into their work by promoting automation, code quality, testability, maintainability, and shared ownership.
* Perform gap analysis across application and platform test coverage and define remediation plans to address identified risks.
* Balance manual and automated testing based on delivery needs, while continuously moving toward automation-first and analytics-driven quality engineering.
* Act as a technical leader and subject-matter expert, proactively resolving issues, managing risks, and escalating concerns appropriately.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.
* 10 plus years of work experience across software quality engineering and end-to-end testing activities, including experience in a technical leadership or lead QA capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience with automation and white-box testing using Java, Python, or both.
* Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Carina, or equivalent web-testing frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience with API and web services testing, including the development or use of API automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases; knowledge of PL/SQL, NoSQL databases, and Linux/UNIX environments is desirable.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with build and deployment processes.
* Understanding of performance, integration, regression, data, security, and non-functional testing practices.
* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues across application, data, and platform layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present quality risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed agile teams.
* Ability to operate independently, take ownership, influence engineering decisions, and drive quality improvements across the organisation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with capital markets, financial risk analytics, counterparty credit risk, xVA, market risk, or related financial services platforms.
* Experience testing calculation-intensive, data-intensive, or regulatory applications.
* Knowledge of cloud-deployed applications, containers, microservices, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
* Experience applying AI-enabled tools and modern engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and quality outcomes.
* Experience establishing quality metrics, governance processes, and continuous improvement programmes for engineering teams.

title: Intern, Founder's Office
description:
**About us**

BrightSense is building technology for the AI age. Its first product is Branly, an AI visibility platform.

How people discover brands has changed. More and more, they ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google's AI answers what to buy, and those answers name only a handful of brands. Branly shows a brand how often it appears in those answers, how it is described and which sources the engines rely on. Then it turns every gap into a specific fix the brand can act on.

Three things shape how we work:

* **Grounded in research.**
  AI search changes every week. We study how each engine finds, trusts and cites its sources, and we keep our methods in step with what the engines do today.
* **Signal over noise.**
  We start from the real questions buyers ask, in their own words. We run them repeatedly across every major engine and read the answers over time, so what we show is a pattern, not a one-off.
* **Customer first.**
  Our customers sit at the centre of everything we build. We learn their category, competitors and goals, then stay alongside them until the work shows up as growth.

**The role**

We are hiring an Intern in the Founder's Office to work directly with the founding team across growth, product, research and operations.

You will run projects end to end: launch campaigns, read user data, speak to customers, test product releases, research competitors and keep day-to-day work moving. Some projects will be planned. Others will come up because something needs fixing that day.

We are an AI-first team. AI is how we research, write, analyse and build, not an add-on. You will be expected to work the same way: hand the first pass to AI, check it properly, and spend your own time on judgement and the parts that need a human.

You will learn how the business works by working across it. We are looking for someone who asks good questions, figures things out and takes a task through to completion.

Full-time internship, 6 months. On-site, Gurgaon. Stipend: ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 a month. You will report to the founding team.

**What you will do**

* **AI-first execution.**
  Use AI tools as your default way of working across research, writing, analysis and reporting. Build simple, repeatable workflows the team can reuse, check every output before it goes anywhere, and share what saves time.
* **Growth and go-to-market.**
  Run outbound and paid experiments end to end: list building, copywriting, campaign execution and performance analysis. Track what works, recommend what to change and stop what does not.
* **User funnel.**
  Track the journey from sign-up to activation and paid conversion. Find where users drop off, investigate why and work with the team to close the gaps.
* **User communication and channels.**
  Write and send the messages that move users forward: onboarding emails, follow-ups, reminders, community posts and content. Own each piece from first draft to publishing, and measure how users respond.
* **Cohort and segment analysis.**
  Use tools such as PostHog, Mixpanel or similar to understand how different user groups behave. Spot patterns, explain what they mean and recommend what to do next.
* **Direct user feedback.**
  Call and message users to understand what is and is not working. Capture feedback in their own words and bring clear findings back to the founding team.
* **Product testing and improvement.**
  Test upcoming releases, catch bugs before customers do and document issues the team can act on. Turn user feedback and funnel gaps into specific product ideas.
* **Competitor and market research.**
  Research competitors and relevant tools. Understand their pricing, strengths and differentiators, and identify where Branly can do better.
* **Operations and urgent priorities.**
  Take ownership of work across vendors, spreadsheets, hiring pipelines, launches and other operational needs. Keep information organised, follow up with the right people and close open tasks.
* **Learn the product inside out.**
  Use Branly the way our customers do. Understand how brands show up in AI answers, so your work in growth, research and support is grounded in the product.

**Who you are**

* A student or recent graduate who wants hands-on experience building and running a business.
* You have taken ownership of something and finished it. This could be an internship project, a campus initiative, a side project or something you built yourself.
* AI-first by habit. You already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity every day, you have used them to get real work done, and you know when an answer needs checking.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can spot a pattern, investigate a drop-off and suggest a concrete fix.
* A clear writer who can put together an email, campaign message or research note that gets to the point.
* Comfortable calling or messaging users, customers and vendors directly to get feedback or move work forward.
* Curious about startups, B2B software and marketing. You take an interest in how products find users and turn them into customers.
* Organised enough to manage several tasks, keep people updated and follow through without repeated reminders.

**Bonus points**

* You have built something with AI: an automation, a custom GPT or Claude project, or a workflow that replaced manual work.
* Hands-on experience with PostHog, Mixpanel, Google Analytics or similar tools.
* You have run an email campaign, built an online community, created content or tested a paid campaign.
* Experience testing a product and documenting bugs clearly.
* You have built a side project, worked at a startup or helped run an online business.

**What it is like working with us**

* **Build in one of marketing's most in-demand categories.**
  More brands want to understand how AI talks about them. You will help build a product that answers that question.
* **Learn to work the AI-first way.**
  You will see how a small team uses AI to do the work of a much larger one, and you will leave with workflows and habits most teams are still figuring out.
* **High ownership, high visibility.**
  You will work side by side with the founders. Your work ships fast, and you will see what it changes.
* **A seat close to the decisions.**
  You will see how growth, product and operations connect, and help shape what the team does next.
* **Learn from founders who have scaled before.**
  You will work closely with a team that has led and grown operations across industries, and you will pick up how it is done.
* **Grow as fast as you learn.**
  As you show what you can handle, you will take on larger projects and more responsibility.

title: Clinical Trials Operations & Product Strategy Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Trialion AI is an AI-native eClinical suite built on a single continuous data model, unifying EDC, ePRO/eCOA, RTSM, eConsent, medical coding, and site CTMS into one product. Every module reads and writes the same records under a single immutable audit trail, eliminating system reconciliation, connector validation, and data migration during protocol amendments. The platform is designed for rapid study build, live deployment of amendments, and data quality at the point of entry, with AI-assisted workflows always overseen and approved by qualified clinical data professionals. Trialion AI is architected to meet global regulatory standards including 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, ICH E6(R3), CDSCO Schedule Y, and the DPDP Act 2023. Built by clinical data and engineering leaders from IQVIA, Vidia, and Aerial Borne, it serves agile CROs, mid-market biopharma, and medical device companies running trials across India and APAC.

**Role Description**
The Clinical Trials Operations & Product Strategy Consultant is a full-time, hybrid role based in Gurugram, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role focuses on shaping product strategy for Trialion’s eClinical platform while ensuring that clinical trial operations are efficient, compliant, and aligned with sponsor and CRO needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include translating trial workflows and regulatory requirements into product features, collaborating with product managers and engineers on study build and data lifecycle design, and conducting operational analyses to improve site and sponsor experiences. The consultant will engage with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback, prioritize product enhancements, and support the design and rollout of new modules and capabilities. The role also involves preparing documentation and operational playbooks, contributing to go-to-market activities, and supporting cross-functional teams in India and APAC.

**Qualifications**

* Strong product strategy and product management skills, with the ability to define vision, roadmap, and use cases for eClinical solutions.
* Excellent analytical skills and research capabilities to evaluate clinical operations, user needs, and market trends.
* Experience in product development within clinical trials or healthcare technology, including collaboration with engineering and design teams.
* Solid understanding of clinical trial operations, data management, and regulatory frameworks such as ICH-GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.
* Prior experience working with CROs, biopharma, or medical device organizations, ideally in India or APAC, US markets.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and operational concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
* Demonstrated capability to work in a hybrid environment, managing onsite collaboration in Gurugram and remote responsibilities independently.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Analyst, TSG Product Management, is assigned to one or a few products. The Analyst is responsible for responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, performing routine updates, and validating changes through testing. This role gathers product insights by tracking key metrics, monitoring usage and adoption, and collecting user feedback through periodic surveys. The Analyst also scopes and drives smaller enhancement requests — translating business needs into clear requirements — while communicating effectively with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure their needs are fulfilled.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**
**Product Maintenance & Analytics (50%)**

* Supports existing enterprise analytics products (e.g., Power BI and Tableau) by responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, investigating root cause and escalating to technical teams or platform specialists when required
* Independently makes complex manual updates based on incoming requests, applying sound judgment to optimize the product
* Runs periodic user surveys and forums to track satisfaction and identify areas for improvement
* Tracks and analyzes key metrics — including dashboards, usage, and adoption — summarizing insights and findings for stakeholders
* Tests routine updates and enhancements to validate functionality and ensure a user-friendly experience

**Manage Enhancement Requests (40%)**

* Elicits requirements on small-to-medium sized requests, working with users to translate use cases and pain points into underlying requirements and potential solutions
* Transforms these requests into actionable work via user stories, process flow diagrams, and other supporting documentation
* Works with appropriate technical teams and third parties to complete these items, prioritizing and communicating dependencies and tradeoffs with key stakeholders throughout

**Develop Domain Knowledge (10%)**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize data, user feedback, and operational metrics into clear insights and recommended actions, and exhibit root-cause thinking

* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred
* Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements, including soliciting use cases, stakeholder requirements, and platform pain points
* Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership
* Strong written communication and documentation skills, including product documentation, status updates, process materials, user guidance, and executive-ready summaries
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging analytics technologies; ability to quickly learn new tools and evaluate capabilities; experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day operations preferred

**Experience**

* Experience supporting technology products, analytics platforms, or business systems, ideally in a product management, product operations, business analyst, or similar role. Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise data platforms is preferred
* Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs
* Experience working in a corporate environment
* Experience solving basic issues in software tools and turning findings into actionable next steps
* Experience supporting users or customers with clear and helpful communication.

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.

**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.

* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers

**Desired Skills**

 Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
   

  

 We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
   

  

**Job Description**
 Delivery Coach / Scrum Master — Salesforce (Primary) \& NetSuite (Secondary)
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Delivery Coach / Scrum Master to lead delivery, primarily for our Salesforce team (approximately 90% of the role), with the remaining 10% supporting the NetSuite team. In this role you will act as a servant\-leader, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, coaching the team on Agile (and other) principles, and creating the conditions for high, sustainable delivery. You will remove impediments, protect the team's focus, and foster a culture of transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong facilitation and coaching skills with familiarity with the Salesforce delivery landscape.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the primary Scrum Master for the Salesforce team (\~90% of the role), facilitating all core Scrum ceremonies.
* Provide Scrum Master support to the NetSuite team as needed (\~10% of the role), coordinating across both workstreams.
* Coach both teams on Agile and Scrum practices, driving continuous improvement.
* Facilitate retrospectives that surface honest insights and produce concrete, tracked improvement actions.
* Identify, track, and remove impediments that block progress across the Salesforce and NetSuite teams.
* Protect the teams from external disruption and help maintain a sustainable pace.
* Partner with product owners to keep backlogs healthy, refined, and well\-prioritised.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies, especially where Salesforce and NetSuite integrate.
* Maintain transparent reporting on sprint health, delivery metrics, and progress for stakeholders.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Solid, demonstrable understanding of Agile principles and the Scrum framework.
* Proven experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and coaching delivery teams.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Effective stakeholder management across technical and business audiences.
* Ability to remove impediments and promote team self\-organisation.
* Proficiency with an Agile work\-tracking tool and delivery reporting.


**Preferred Experience**
* 3–5 years in a Scrum Master role.
* Experience supporting Salesforce delivery teams or projects.
* Exposure to NetSuite projects or ERP delivery.

 Tools \& Systems
   

  

* Salesforce — primary supported platform (\~90%).
* NetSuite — secondary supported platform (\~10%).

 Accountability Measures

* Impediment resolution: blockers identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Delivery predictability: consistent achievement of sprint commitments and stable flow.

description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 In a world where data is critical to BCG's success, we are building first\-class, foundational capabilities and products across the firm. Within this vision, LEAP is delivering BCG's new Learning platform to power the firm's learning and development needs.
   

  

 Initially, you’ll work within the Data Product squad to build a custom data product in Snowflake as part of a broader transformation program of BCG’s learning technology. The data product will help enable AI\-driven learning and make learning data accessible to other teams and systems, including, for example, staffing and analytics. When the program has ended, you’ll be part of a Learning squad with RtB as its scope.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop well\-structured Agile user stories and acceptance criteria that enable effective solution delivery, and owning your area of backlog
* Analyze processes and data needs, contributing to solution design and identifying practical approaches to business problems.
* Coordinate functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
* Support release readiness and implementation, identifying issues and working with technical teams to resolve them.
* Elicit, document, and validate requirements by engaging multiple stakeholder groups and subject matter experts.
* Write clear, well\-structured user stories and acceptance criteria understandable by both technical and functional colleagues.
* Create, update, and maintain requirements documentation (e.g., PRDs / functional specifications).
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, anticipating questions and translating technical details into plain language.
* Manage and triage support requests in a query management system (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Proactively flag risks and dependencies, keeping learner impact and business value as the priority.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

***Education***
* Bachelor's degree required.
* 5–8 years of experience as a business / systems analyst, ideally supporting or configuring enterprise applications.


**Experience / Knowledge**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5\-7 years of experience with Learning or HR applications.
* Experience with learning management or experience platforms; Docebo experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with data products, third\-party platforms, and SaaS technology solutions.
* Working technical fluency with Snowflake, querying databases, and querying APIs to understand and validate data.
* Strong Agile experience, including writing user stories and working with Jira, sprints, and ceremonies.
* Experience developing and executing functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience using AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The Business Analyst is a role within the Data Product Squad, part of LEAP in BCG's digital products organisation. Reporting to the IT Director, you will work day\-to\-day with your Product Owner, Chapter Leads, Scrum Master, and squad members, as well as functional business partners, subject matter experts, and IT colleagues. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to analyse, configure, and evolve BCG's new Learning platform, supporting both day\-to\-day operations and transformative change.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You're Good At**
* Translating learning and business needs into product requirements — asking the right questions and pushing past surface\-level answers.
* Writing clear, well\-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements documentation.
* Communicating clearly, both verbally and in writing, with all staff levels including leadership; excellent listening skills.
* Engaging and managing stakeholders across business, functional, and IT groups, and collaborating remotely with global experts.
* Being outcome\-focused — keeping learner impact and business value front of mind.
* Owning your workstream — taking responsibility for your area of the backlog and delivery, proactively flagging risks.
* Managing data definitions and basic governance — flagging when a decision has governance implications.
* Working within an Agile framework.
